typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Claim_ID as string,
		Claim_Line as string,
		Member_ID as string,
		Employer_ID as string,
		Prescription_Date as string,
		Filled_Date as string,
		Quantity as string,
		Quantity_Units as string,
		Days_Supply as string,
		NDC as string,
		Drug_Name as string,
		Therapy_Class as string,
		Generic_Indicator as string,
		Formulary_Indicator as string,
		Line_Charge as string,
		Allowed_Amount as string,
		Member_Responsibility as string,
		Plan_Paid as string,
		Prescribers_DEA_Number as string,
		Prescribers_Physician_ID as string,
		Dispensing_Facility_ID as string,
		Mail_Order as string,
		Dispense_as_Written as string,
		Paid_Date as string,
		Posted_Date as string,
		Claim_Status as string,
		Denial_Reason as string,
		Adjustment_Claim_Indicator as string,
		Adjusted_Claim_ID as string,
		Source_System as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select   LTRIM(RTRIM([Claim_ID] )) AS [Claim_ID]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Claim_Line])) AS [Claim_Line]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_ID])) AS [Member_ID]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Employer_ID])) AS [Employer_ID]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Prescription_Date])) AS [Prescription_Date]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Filled_Date])) AS [Filled_Date]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Quantity])) AS [Quantity]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Quantity_Units])) AS [Quantity_Units]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Days_Supply])) AS [Days_Supply]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([NDC])) AS [NDC]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Drug_Name])) AS [Drug_Name]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Therapy_Class])) AS [Therapy_Class]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Generic_Indicator])) AS [Generic_Indicator]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Formulary_Indicator])) AS [Formulary_Indicator]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Line_Charge])) AS [Line_Charge]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Allowed_Amount])) AS [Allowed_Amount]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_Responsibility])) AS [Member_Responsibility]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Plan_Paid])) AS [Plan_Paid]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Prescribers_DEA_Number])) AS [Prescribers_DEA_Number]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Prescribers_Physician_ID])) AS [Prescribers_Physician_ID]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Dispensing_Facility_ID])) AS [Dispensing_Facility_ID]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Mail_Order])) AS [Mail_Order]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Dispense_as_Written])) AS [Dispense_as_Written]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Paid_Date])) AS [Paid_Date]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Posted_Date])) AS [Posted_Date]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Claim_Status])) AS [Claim_Status]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Denial_Reason])) AS [Denial_Reason]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Adjustment_Claim_Indicator])) AS [Adjustment_Claim_Indicator]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Adjusted_Claim_ID])) AS [Adjusted_Claim_ID]   ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Source_System])) AS [Source_System]   FROM [EXTRACT].FL_3M_Pharmacy',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> Pharmacy
Pharmacy derive(Claim_ID = Claim_ID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		Drug_Name as string,
		Posted_Date as string,
		Prescription_Date as string,
		Dispensing_Facility_ID as string,
		NDC as string,
		Claim_ID as string,
		Plan_Paid as string,
		Adjustment_Claim_Indicator as string,
		Denial_Reason as string,
		Employer_ID as string,
		Member_Responsibility as string,
		Allowed_Amount as string,
		Days_Supply as string,
		Prescribers_Physician_ID as string,
		Claim_Line as string,
		Adjusted_Claim_ID as string,
		Paid_Date as string,
		Dispense_as_Written as string,
		Quantity as string,
		Source_System as string,
		Mail_Order as string,
		Quantity_Units as string,
		Filled_Date as string,
		Formulary_Indicator as string,
		Line_Charge as string,
		Member_ID as string,
		Claim_Status as string,
		Therapy_Class as string,
		Prescribers_DEA_Number as string,
		Generic_Indicator as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Drug_Name,
		Posted_Date,
		Prescription_Date,
		Dispensing_Facility_ID,
		NDC,
		Claim_ID,
		Plan_Paid,
		Adjustment_Claim_Indicator,
		Denial_Reason,
		Employer_ID,
		Member_Responsibility,
		Allowed_Amount,
		Days_Supply,
		Prescribers_Physician_ID,
		Claim_Line,
		Adjusted_Claim_ID,
		Paid_Date,
		Dispense_as_Written,
		Quantity,
		Source_System,
		Mail_Order,
		Quantity_Units,
		Filled_Date,
		Formulary_Indicator,
		Line_Charge,
		Member_ID,
		Claim_Status,
		Therapy_Class,
		Prescribers_DEA_Number,
		Generic_Indicator)) ~> FlatFileDestination
